description: Cross-language contract for the warm-up strategies (US3, FR-012..FR-015, SEC-007, ADR 0003). Pre-provision pools reconcile to a per-definition target and refill on consumption; the target-size ceiling is enforced; keepalive fires the probe before the idle timeout. All timing uses a deterministic virtual clock: no real sleeps and no live network.

cases.description: A pool reconciles to its target, and after one session is consumed a second reconcile refills back to the target.
Two agent definitions with distinct target sizes each reconcile to their own target, independently.
Constructing a pool with a target above the configured maximum is rejected with TargetSizeExceeded.
Keepalive fires the probe for each session once per interval, well before the idle timeout, driven by the virtual clock.
Keepalive uses exclusively the user-supplied probe for each session; Stoke sends no application traffic of its own.
